notes.title: The game has been released. Welcome to download the game！
notes.content: Super bad hero has been released. Welcome to download the game！We have directly reduced the price and will no longer use discounts during the initial release period. Thank you!

notes.title: Super bad hero will be released on February 8, 2024
notes.content:
The physics shooting game Super bad hero will be released on February 8, 2024 and will offer a 10% price discount！"Super bad hero" is a fun physics shooting adventure game with high shooting freedom and physical feedback effects. You can constantly eat guns, steal money, upgrade guns and armor to eliminate all evil enemies！
